WHY PLOTTING? Sooner or later, everyane needs to produce plots Helps us visualize data to see trends, pose computational questions to probe If you join 6.1008,you will make extensive use of them For those of you leaving us after next week, this is a valuable way to visualize data Example of leveraging an existing library, rather than writing procedures from scratch Python provides libraries for Plotting Numerical computation Stochastic computation Many others
